content.comment_body: Hello, I'm unable to connect to [product_name] using a USB/232 adaptor ([article_no]). Here are my steps: 1) Installed [product_name] software version [version_no] and upgraded to [version_no] 2) Plugged in the adaptor 3) Installed the adaptor driver (from CD that came with adaptor) 4) When new hardware was detected, software couldn't be found. Did I miss a step or forget something important?

Hi, For some USB-serial converters, the driver needs to be installed before connecting the device. I suggest: 1) Uninstall the driver 2) Restart your PC 3) Reinstall the driver 4) Then plug in the cable. Be aware that some converters may not be compatible at all. You can also check [url] or search using keywords like "[product_name] usb converter".

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering problems connecting their computers to [product_name] modules via USB to RS232 adaptors, mainly due to issues with driver installation and recognition. This affects their ability to use the associated software for programming and monitoring. There is confusion regarding the correct driver installation sequence and the compatibility of certain adaptors.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an easy and reliable process for installing drivers and configuring third-party USB-serial adaptors to effectively access and manage [product_name] modules.
